automation_rule_inactivity_valid.name: automation_rule_inactivity_valid
automation_rule_inactivity_valid.value: ("automation_rules"."trigger_kind" in ('first_checkout','reward_ready') and "automation_rules"."inactivity_days" is null) or ("automation_rules"."trigger_kind" = 'inactive' and "automation_rules"."inactivity_days" is not null and "automation_rules"."inactivity_days" between 7 and 365)

ledger_nfc_actor_valid.name: ledger_nfc_actor_valid
ledger_nfc_actor_valid.value: ("ledger_entries"."source" = 'nfc_tap' and "ledger_entries"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("ledger_entries"."source" <> 'nfc_tap' and "ledger_entries"."actor_user_id" is not null)

location_coordinates_valid.name: location_coordinates_valid
location_coordinates_valid.value: ("locations"."latitude" is null and "locations"."longitude" is null) or ("locations"."latitude" is not null and "locations"."longitude" is not null and "locations"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "locations"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

plate_link_action_valid.name: plate_link_action_valid
plate_link_action_valid.value: ("plate_link_events"."action" = 'link' and "plate_link_events"."old_program_id" is null and "plate_link_events"."new_program_id" is not null) or ("plate_link_events"."action" = 'relink' and "plate_link_events"."old_program_id" is not null and "plate_link_events"."new_program_id" is not null) or ("plate_link_events"."action" = 'unlink' and "plate_link_events"."old_program_id" is not null and "plate_link_events"."new_program_id" is null)

referral_settings_bonus_valid.name: referral_settings_bonus_valid
referral_settings_bonus_valid.value: "referral_settings"."referrer_bonus" between 0 and 1000 and "referral_settings"."referred_bonus" between 0 and 1000 and (not "referral_settings"."enabled" or "referral_settings"."referrer_bonus" + "referral_settings"."referred_bonus" > 0)

referral_bonus_snapshot_valid.name: referral_bonus_snapshot_valid
referral_bonus_snapshot_valid.value: "referrals"."referrer_bonus" between 0 and 1000 and "referrals"."referred_bonus" between 0 and 1000 and "referrals"."referrer_bonus" + "referrals"."referred_bonus" > 0

secure_tag_binding_valid.name: secure_tag_binding_valid
secure_tag_binding_valid.value: ("secure_tags"."tenant_id" is not null and "secure_tags"."location_id" is not null and "secure_tags"."program_id" is not null and "secure_tags"."status" <> 'unlinked') or ("secure_tags"."tenant_id" is null and "secure_tags"."location_id" is null and "secure_tags"."program_id" is null and "secure_tags"."plate_label" is not null and "secure_tags"."status" in ('unlinked','revoked'))

wallet_pass_revoke_valid.name: wallet_pass_revoke_valid
wallet_pass_revoke_valid.value: ("wallet_passes"."revoked_at" is null and "wallet_passes"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("wallet_passes"."revoked_at" is not null and "wallet_passes"."revoke_reason" is not null and "wallet_passes"."revoke_reason" in ('reissued','closed','superseded'))
